comparisons.reason: Different constructs and aggregation. Item 0 is an all-comments check: every comment must rely solely on abstract normative principles (rights, justice, ought) with no concrete details, and any non-normative argument gives 0. Item 1 is an any-comment check: at least one comment must be an abstract logical rebuttal (definitions, inference, consistency) with no named real-world example or analogy. Item 1 is not limited to normative claims. The empty-list rule also differs: item 0 returns null and item 1 returns 0.
